# Regarded — H3 Sync Challenge Workflow Index

This canvas is a **production map**, not a fake one-click render graph.

The exact runnable workflows are S01-S13 in `selected_shots/`.

The project intentionally stays close to ComfyUI's stock MiniMax H3 ref2va workflow and explores how far reference hierarchy, linked H3 video/audio, sampling changes, encoder variants, resolution, and prompt structure can carry a continuous narrative.

**Final title:** Regarded  
**Reported runtime:** ~87.47 s  
**Final delivery target:** 1280×720 / 24 fps  
**Core:** ComfyUI 0.33.0  
**Frontend:** 1.49.6  
**GPU:** RTX 3090 Ti 24 GB  
**Sampler:** res_multistep  
**Native generation:** H3 video + stereo audio

nodes.title: S01-S03 — Approach / Installation
widgets_values:
## S01-S03 — Establish the physical world

**S01** — 14 s, 1 MP. Riot + environment refs. Native footsteps, rain, dialogue. Turbo setting 10.

**S02** — 10 s, 1 MP. Full 25-step, Turbo disabled. Orrery reveal across the crest; mud-to-stone footstep transition.

**S03** — 6.5 s, 1 MP. Prior H3 video becomes a visual continuity reference. Adds mechanism detail to enforce the two-moon Orrery geometry. Turbo setting 4 / full fallback 25.

This is where the workflow stops being only “reference image → new clip” and starts treating a previous H3 shot as production state.

nodes.title: S04-S07 — Quorum / Linked Audio
widgets_values:
## S04-S07 — Encounter and audiovisual continuity

**S04** — prior H3 video preserves Riot's position, wetness, screen direction, weather, and Orrery motion while the camera changes and reveals the Quorum.

**S05** — introduces `firstskyinprogress.wav` as an H3 voice-timbre reference and carries previous H3 environmental audio.

**S06** — keeps the established Highland/Orrery audio while generating the layered Quorum exchange. 9 s, 1 MP, Turbo 7.

**S07** — 7.5 s, 1 MP, Turbo 9. Carries the preceding “We are” harmonic and environment into “Heed” and the skyward camera move.

This is the clearest linked-pass evidence in the sequence.

nodes.title: S08-S10 — Homeworld Reveal / Transition
widgets_values:
## S08-S10 — Expand the reference stack

**S08** — 7 s, 1 MP, Turbo 11. Adds the planet reference while preserving prior H3 video/audio and Quorum voice identity.

**S09** — 7.5 s, 1 MP, Turbo 10 / full fallback 25. Continues from `shot5continue.mp4` with its H3 audio plus the voice reference.

**S10** — 4.5 s, 1 MP, W4A8 mixed text encoder, Turbo 8 / full fallback 25. Uses two prior video streams and both prior audio streams. Ends with an Orrery ring occluding the frame to hand off into the orbital RKV shot.

nodes.title: S11-S12 — RKV / Damaged Planet
widgets_values:
## S11-S12 — Impact sequence

**S11** — 5 s, **2 MP**, W4A8 mixed. Turbo 12 / full fallback 32. One authoritative pre-impact planet ref. Tiny intermittent RKV cue → hidden far-side upper-right impact → white-blue sensor saturation. Native telemetry/clipping/overload sound.

**S12** — 8 s, **2 MP**, NVFP4. Turbo 12 / full fallback 25. Pre-impact + post-impact planet refs + prior impact video **visual only**. The previous video's audio output is not wired into H3. New native audio is prompted as overload recovery, telemetry and signal failure.

This split was used to keep the impact and the damaged-state reveal individually controllable.

nodes.title: S13 — Aftermath / Closing Line
widgets_values:
## S13 — Return to Riot

8 s, 1 MP, W4A8 mixed, Turbo 6 / full fallback 25, `ref_image_size=max`.

References:
- Riot identity
- authoritative henge position
- Orrery identity
- post-impact planet
- preceding video as visual-only transition state
- Quorum voice reference

The space audio is deliberately **not** inherited. H3 re-establishes ringing → Highland rain/wind/breathing → one Orrery click → off-screen Quorum whisper:

**“Pray... that you have been regarded... in time.”**

nodes.title: DEPENDENCIES / NAMING NOTE
widgets_values:
## Dependencies

**Diffusion:** `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`

**Video VAE actually selected:** `minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors`

**Audio VAE:** `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors`

**Text encoders used:** NVFP4 AWQ and W4A8 mixed

**Turbo LoRA:** `minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors`, strength 1

**Video/audio loaders:** Video Helper Suite (`VHS_LoadVideo`, `VHS_LoadAudioUpload`)

### Naming gotcha
Some working-template nodes are still titled **Lightning LoRA**. The actual file loaded is the MiniMax H3 Ref2V Turbo LoRA. The old node title is not a claim that a separate Lightning LoRA was used.

nodes.title: WHY THIS IS A MASTER INDEX, NOT A MEGA-GRAPH
widgets_values:
## Why the exact workflows stay separate

These clips were generated as purpose-specific H3 passes, sometimes feeding prior output into the next pass.

Copying thirteen entire graphs onto one canvas would make a huge document, but it would not make unrelated shots technically “linked.” Connections are only called linked when prior H3 output actually served as a later reference.

The exact per-shot JSON files preserve reproducibility. This index exposes the production logic and meaningful parameter changes without manufacturing a fake one-click pipeline.

nodes.title: AUDIO PROVENANCE
widgets_values:
## Audio provenance

The selected workflows decode video and audio from the same H3 latent.

`firstskyinprogress.wav` is used as a **reference input** for the Quorum voice.

Several S05-S10 workflows also wire prior H3-generated audio into the next H3 reference stack for environmental/vocal continuity.

S11 generates impact telemetry and overload natively.

S12 uses its prior impact clip visually only; its prior audio output is not connected.

S13 uses its prior clip visually only and separately connects the Quorum voice reference.

The final Resolve/Audacity pass used trims, clip-gain automation, short audio crossfades/fades, cleanup/EQ where needed, conservative dynamics processing and a safety limiter. No separately produced replacement soundtrack was added.

The final pre-vision recognition/Quorum exchange was lifted about 2.5 dB after QC so the intentional whisper remained intelligible on ordinary playback.

nodes.title: ITERATION SUMMARY
widgets_values:
## What repeatedly changed

- extra / missing moons
- impossible Orrery ring geometry
- wrong entry position and character blocking
- loss of screen direction
- planet geography drift
- impact location drift
- generic explosion behavior
- symmetrical shockwaves
- overcomplicated choral sound
- verbose prompts causing extra objects and weaker camera control

The production response was not one magic setting. It was stronger reference hierarchy, dedicated position/mechanism refs, prior-video continuity, prior-audio continuity where useful, shorter technical prompts, lower-res composition tests, and shot-specific Turbo/full-step choices.
